Player credited as Mike Gemme (byline 'michael "Deck" Gemme'; wiki page Mike Gemme, Michael Gemme redirects). The post says Alex Tennet originally made the deck for him for Worlds; this is Gemme's post-Reflections II adaptation, not yet played.
player_note: The post says the original version, which Alex Tennet made for him for Worlds, 'went 2-2 on day 1, and 1-1 in the team tourney'; this list was adapted after Reflections II and he hadn't played it yet.
